password.intro: A password keeps other people on your Wi-Fi out of your videos. It is asked on your phone, over Tailscale and through tunnels, never on this computer.
password.prompt: Type a password, or press Enter to generate one:
password.generated:
Your password is: {password}
Write it down: only a scrambled copy is kept, so it cannot be shown again.
password.saved: Password saved. The editor can now be opened from a phone on the same Wi-Fi.
password.skipped: No password for now: the editor can only be opened on this computer.
password.removed: Password removed. The editor can only be opened on this computer.
password.status.set: A password is set. The editor is reachable on the local network.
password.status.unset: No password is set. The editor can only be opened on this computer.
password.error.too_common: That password is too easy to guess.
launcher.title: Legendária
launcher.local_only: Only this computer can open the editor. Set a password to use it from your phone.
launcher.password.title: Access password
launcher.info.title: Using the editor from your phone
launcher.info.text: With a password, you can open the editor from your phone on the same Wi-Fi, and from anywhere through Tailscale or Headscale. Visitors on your Wi-Fi still cannot get in, and they never see the files on this computer. The password is asked only on the phone, not on this computer.
launcher.info.link: Read more: local network, Tailscale and Headscale
launcher.no_tk: The window could not be opened because tkinter is not installed. Starting in the terminal instead.
